report.notes:
Root cause addressed: snapshot.js now groups inline-adjacent visible text nodes of one block (no
, block element or whitespace-only node between) into one run = one group id with no separator, masked as a whole, for page text (chunks + pieces), headings, label pieces and contenteditable value pieces (newRun/blockOf/isInline helpers). Defence in depth in both layers (redact.py _split_url_parts, snapshot.js splitUrlParts, same rule): secret-naming key with empty value ('k=' or 'k' '=') masks the next token's value; 'scheme://user:' followed within two tokens by '...@' loses the userinfo. Regression: Chromium page with the five R42-01 forms (no_selection, ctrl_a) asserting no secret in the Brain body or in snapshot pieces/text/headings, plus Python unit cases; checked against a git-archive export of 78006f9 (10 failed, 1 passed: the readability guard, which passes on both versions); after the change 11 passed. Full tests/assist: 2221 passed (that run started before the R42 file was added and does not include it). tests/web and Flutter tests were not run; a text search of tests/web found no source file referencing snapshot.js, redact_text or uri_assist. Known trade-offs: in prose, a word after a bare secret-sounding key followed by '=' is masked (e.g. 'password = hunter2', 'key = value'), and inline-adjacent nodes in headings, labels and values now join with no separator where they were space-joined before.
